description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the LeaveRequestCommentAPI in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It contains multiple test cases verifying the behavior of the API for creating, retrieving, and handling leave request comments, including validation and exception scenarios.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LeaveRequestCommentAPI within the OrangeHRM system. It covers scenarios like creating comments, retrieving multiple comments, handling not found errors, validation rules, and not implemented methods.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestCommentService
methods.description: Tests that the API correctly returns an instance of LeaveRequestCommentService.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a leave request comment, verifying the normalization of the returned object.

methods.name: testCreateLeaveRequestRecordNotFound
methods.description: Verifies behavior when the associated leave request record is not found during comment creation.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates the rules for the create comment API call.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all comments for a leave request, checking normalization.

methods.name: testGetAllLeaveRequestRecordNotFound
methods.description: Verifies behavior when leave request record is not found during get all comments.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates the rules for the get all comments API call.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures the delete method is not implemented and throws the appropriate exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures the validation rule for delete throws not implemented exception.
